title: Compact handoff recovery and published version visibility
summary: Replace verbose handoff authoring with a compact resume capsule and expose the published version below the Web UI project name.
description: Fix the incomplete handoff contract centered in packages/plan-core/src/handoff-context.ts and packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts, where handoff_prepare and handoff_write still require a verbose canonical scaffold, completeness audit, and cold-start inventory to be repeated in Markdown even after overflow externalization. Preserve enough durable context for a cold agent to resume: current objective, completed and partial work, exact file/symbol resume point, decisions and constraints, verification, blockers, and ordered next actions. Move evidence into planner-owned structured metadata or generated supporting documents without requiring prose duplication, enforce the compact inline budget before persistence, and add core/MCP/Pi/server/Web UI regressions. In parallel, update packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/layout/top-nav.tsx and its data loader/API contract so the current published Agent Plan version is visible directly below the project name in the header, with a stable fallback and responsive accessible markup. Preserve existing header navigation, project naming, styling, and runtime behavior; verify installed-version provenance and browser rendering.

tasks.title: Replace verbose handoff authoring with compact resume capsules
tasks.description:
Refactor packages/plan-core/src/handoff-context.ts and packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts so handoff_prepare/handoff_write require only compact resume-critical context instead of repeating the full completeness audit and cold-start inventory in Markdown. Persist audit/evidence as planner-owned structured metadata or generated supporting documents, preserve resume-readiness and read-back integrity, enforce the inline budget before persistence, and update MCP, Pi, server, Web UI, skills, and regressions for concise cold-agent recovery without losing exact resume location, decisions, verification, blockers, or next actions.

---
**Completion summary:**
Replaced verbose handoff authoring with compact resume capsules. Core now accepts omitted legacy completenessAudit, coldStartInventory, sourceReviews, and omissionsFound, derives planner-owned evidence from persisted state, and preserves legacy explicit evidence compatibility and resume-readiness hashing. MCP and Pi no longer expose the full audit/inventory arrays in operational prepare output or require duplicate prose; planner skill guidance and generated plugin copies now require only resume-critical focus/state/constraints/verification/blockers/ordered next actions. Added compact handoff regressions and updated legacy expectations. Files touched include packages/plan-core/src/handoff-context.ts, packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts, packages/plan-core/planner-skill.md, packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts, packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts, generated plugin skill files, and focused tests. Verification: core/MCP/Pi/server builds passed; 85/85 focused handoff/core/MCP/Pi tests passed; pnpm verify:final passed fingerprint b25f7498821d across build, typecheck, 601-test coverage, plugin synchronization, capability audit, browser E2E, and packed-install smoke. Remaining: T397 published version header and T398 checklist persistence are separate planned tasks; no commit or push performed.

---
**Completion summary:**
Fixed the actual late handoff failure: concise capsules are now accepted without reproducing scaffold or legacy headings; only empty content and unresolved {{REQUIRED:...}} placeholders are rejected. Removed the legacy fallback that emitted obsolete required-section lists, updated MCP/Pi prepare guidance and canonical planner skill to state that headings are optional, and added regressions for free-form concise capsules and placeholder rejection with no persistence. Verification: core/MCP/Pi/server builds, focused handoff suites (18 core, 47 MCP, 17 Pi, 10 server) and git diff --check passed; canonical pnpm verify:final passed 6734f898b934 (build, typecheck, coverage, plugin sync, capability audit, browser E2E, packed-install smoke). T398 checklist persistence remains paused and must be resumed next; no commit or push.

tasks.title: Persist task checklist writes and reject false success
tasks.description:
Audit the planner-task-update checklist path across packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts, packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts, packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts, packages/plan-server/src/serve.ts, and task update regressions. When a checklist payload is accepted, persist the normalized checklist to the owning phase file, read it back before returning success, and return updated:false with a typed error or no-op reason when persistence does not occur. Add a regression that reads the phase JSON directly and verifies checklist items survive the mutation, preserving planner-owned checklist identity and existing task update semantics.

---
**Completion summary:**
Hardened checklist persistence end to end. PlanStore.updateTask now reads the owning phase back from disk and throws typed TASK_CHECKLIST_PERSISTENCE_FAILED instead of allowing false success when the normalized checklist is absent or differs. MCP and Pi planner-task-update/task_update use the semantic core path and return updated:false, isError, and typed errorCode on persistence failure. Added direct phase-file regressions for core, MCP, Pi, and plan-server, plus a simulated core read-back mismatch regression. Verification: affected builds and 75 focused core/MCP/Pi/server tests passed; canonical pnpm verify:final passed 187da4227dc7 (build, typecheck, coverage, plugin sync, capability audit, browser E2E, packed-install smoke); git diff --check clean. No commit or push performed.
